en.title: App development for small businesses and startups
en.description: Custom apps for Australian small businesses and startups: start with a testable prototype, agree the first version, then build and release in phases.
en.h1: Apps that start small and prove themselves
en.included_title: What we agree in the scope

process.title: Understand the job
process.body: We discuss your business, audience, existing tools, budget and the problem you want to solve.

process.title: Agree the scope
process.body: You receive a written proposal covering the work, deliverables, schedule, costs and payment stages.

process.title: Design, build, review
process.body: Review layouts and working previews at agreed milestones. We confirm any change in scope before proceeding.

process.title: Launch & hand over
process.body: We check the agreed flows, help you launch and hand over accounts and guidance. Ongoing support is agreed with you.

en.cities_body: We work online with businesses across Australia and overseas. If you'd prefer to meet in person, we can arrange it in Sydney, Melbourne or Perth.
en.answer: We develop apps for Australian small businesses and startups, beginning with a prototype that can be tested. We agree a useful first version before building and releasing in phases. The platform, testing, release support and maintenance are assessed and set out in a written proposal, with English and Chinese communication and mainly online collaboration.
for_items: Businesses with a clear, repeated task that customers or team members need to complete, rather than a request for an app without a defined use.
Small teams that want to test the proposed flow before deciding how much of the product belongs in the first version.
Owners comparing a mobile-friendly website, an existing tool and a custom app for a specific business problem.
included: Discussion of the problem, users and repeat-use scenarios to decide whether an app is a suitable approach.
A testable prototype and a defined first-version scope, with review points before further development.
Assessment of iOS, Android or a web app, based on the agreed use rather than a platform chosen in advance.
A written plan for development phases, testing, release responsibilities, account access and code handover.
not_included: Every future feature in the first release. Later work is scoped and agreed separately.
Testing, store submission support or ongoing maintenance without a specific agreement covering them.
A platform or release commitment before the proposed flow and requirements have been assessed.

sections.title: Decide whether an app is needed
body: Not every business problem needs an app. We look at how often people will use it and what they need to do. An existing tool or a mobile-friendly website may be enough; a custom app makes sense when it solves a clear, repeat-use problem.

Start with the action a person needs to take, how often it happens and the information involved. If a website explains the service and handles the required interaction, that may be sufficient. If an existing tool already solves the task, consider it before commissioning custom development.

sections.title: A prototype before a larger build
body: A prototype makes the proposed flow concrete enough to test. Review what users need to see and do before adding the rest of the feature list. The first version should have a clearly described purpose and boundary, so a new request can be recognised as a change in scope.

We assess the platform after discussing that flow. iOS, Android and web apps have different release arrangements; the proposal states which approach is being built and what testing and publication support it covers. Maintenance and later development are separately agreed rather than left implicit.

en.pricing_body: App projects are quoted in writing after the problem, prototype and first-version boundaries are discussed. Platform choices, features and connections affect the work involved. The proposal separates development, testing, release support and maintenance, and explains the payment stages. Account and code ownership are written into the agreement. Later features are confirmed before extra work begins, so the first version remains a scope you can review.

faq.q: Do I need an app or a website?
faq.a: Not always. We look at how often people will use it and what they need to do. An existing tool or a mobile-friendly website may be enough; a custom app makes sense when it solves a clear, repeat-use problem.

faq.q: iOS, Android or a web app?
faq.a: We assess this after understanding the users and the flow. The proposal names the platform and defines its development and release scope. A platform choice is not a promise that every possible device or distribution route is included.

faq.q: What belongs in the first version?
faq.a: The useful flow agreed after the prototype review. We define its features, review milestones and boundaries in writing. Requests beyond those boundaries are discussed as further work, allowing you to consider their costs before extending the project.

faq.q: Who owns the code and accounts?
faq.a: Project-specific code ownership, third-party licences, service accounts and handover conditions are stated in the agreement before development. Ask about access and future maintenance at that point so the delivery arrangements match the way you plan to run the app.

en.cta_body: Describe the repeated task you want the app to support and who would use it. If you have an initial idea or flow, include it. We can discuss a prototype, the first useful version and the work to quote.

zh.title: App 开发与原型（小企业与初创团队）
zh.description: 为澳洲小企业与初创团队开发 App：先做可测试的原型，再确定第一版范围，分阶段开发和上线。
zh.h1: App 开发：先做能测试的第一版

process.title: 了解需求
process.body: 聊清楚你的生意、顾客、现有工具、预算，以及这次希望解决的问题。

process.title: 确认方案与报价
process.body: 提供书面方案，说明工作范围、交付内容、时间安排、费用与付款节点。

process.title: 设计、开发与确认
process.body: 按约定节点查看设计和可操作预览。范围有变化时，先和你确认再继续。

process.title: 上线与交接
process.body: 检查约定功能、协助上线，交接账户与使用说明，再按需要安排后续支持。

zh.cities_body: 我们以线上合作为主，服务全澳及海外客户；如需当面沟通，可在悉尼、墨尔本、珀斯安排。
zh.answer: 我们为澳洲小企业与初创团队开发 App，先做可测试的原型，再确认有用的第一版，分阶段开发和上线。平台、测试、发布支持及维护经评估后写入方案，中英文沟通，以线上合作为主。
for_items: 有明确、持续的顾客或团队操作需求，而不是还没定义用途就想做 App 的商家。
希望先测试流程，再决定第一版范围的小团队。
针对具体业务问题，在手机友好网站、现成工具与定制 App 之间做选择的商家。
included: 讨论问题、使用者与持续使用场景，判断 App 是否合适。
可测试原型与明确的第一版范围，继续开发前确认检查节点。
按约定用途评估 iOS、Android 或网页应用，不预先锁定平台。
书面规划开发阶段、测试、发布责任、账号权限及代码交接。
not_included: 第一版不默认包含未来所有功能，后续工作另行确定范围。
测试、上架支持与持续维护，均需具体约定。
评估流程与需求前，不作平台或发布安排承诺。

sections.title: 先判断需不需要 App
body: 不是每个业务问题都需要 App。我们会先看使用频率和实际场景。现成工具或手机友好的网站可能已经够用；当有明确、持续的使用需求时，再考虑定制 App。
先说明使用者要做什么、多久做一次、涉及哪些信息。如果网站已能说明服务并完成所需交互，可能就够用；现成工具能解决问题时，也应先考虑。

sections.title: 先做原型，再扩大开发
body: 原型让流程具体到可以测试。加入更多功能前，先检查使用者要看什么、做什么。第一版有清楚目的与边界，才能辨认新增请求是否改变范围。
讨论流程后再评估平台。iOS、Android 与网页应用的发布安排不同，方案中说明选择的方式，以及包含哪些测试与发布支持。维护和后续开发另行约定。

zh.pricing_body: App 在讨论问题、原型及第一版边界后书面报价。平台、功能和接入影响工作量。方案分别说明开发、测试、发布支持与维护，以及付款节点。账号和代码归属写入协议；后续功能先确认再开展，让第一版范围可审核。

faq.q: 我需要 App 还是网站？
faq.a: 不一定。我们会先看使用频率和实际场景。现成工具或手机友好的网站可能已经够用；当有明确、持续的使用需求时，再考虑定制 App。
了解使用者和流程后评估，方案里写明平台及开发、发布范围。选择某个平台，不代表默认包含所有设备或发布渠道。
原型确认后约定的实用流程。书面定义功能、确认节点和边界；超出部分作为后续工作讨论，让你在扩大范围前考虑费用。
开发前在协议中写明项目专属代码归属、第三方许可、服务账号及交接条件。此时确认访问与后续维护，让交付安排符合你运营 App 的方式。

zh.cta_body: 描述 App 要支持的持续使用场景与使用者。有初步想法或流程也可以提供，一起讨论原型、实用第一版及报价范围。
